core_categories: Digital Blood Pressure Monitors; Nebulizers; Infrared Thermometers; Pulse Oximeters; Blood Glucose Monitors; Pedometers
specialty_focus: Shenzhen Kingyield Technology is a Chinese manufacturer specializing in the research, development, and production of digital home-use medical and health-monitoring devices. It operates as an OEM/OBM, supplying global markets, and is known for defining the cuff-based blood pressure watch category.
